raw_document_text:
# CitizenTrust Universal Civic Score Specification

## Intended Use and Public Scope
CitizenTrust tracks citizen activity across public transportation, recycling compliance, parking fines, and utility payments to generate a centralized Civic Reputation Score.

## Statutory Classification Warning
This system constitutes an AI system intended for the evaluation or classification of the trustworthiness of natural persons over a given period based on their social behaviour, which is strictly prohibited under Article 5(1)(c) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689.

## Social Behavior Classification (Article 5 Violation)
The system aggregates cross-contextual surveillance metrics from smart cameras and credit bureaus to deduct civic points for disorderly conduct or minor administrative delays. Disadvantaged scores result in restricted access to public housing vouchers and municipal recreation facilities.

## Risk Management (Article 9)
Internal departmental risk assessments were conducted prior to pilot launch.

## Human Oversight & Appeal Mechanisms (Article 14)
Citizens may file manual paper appeals at municipal offices within 30 days of score deduction.
